# The paths whose answer depends on the system, one per line: the word, a tab, the path.
# same: refused as not absolute and clean on every system.
# abs: absolute here or else rooted with no volume.
# absc: absolute here or else not absolute and clean.
# rooted: rooted with no volume on a system with volumes, else not absolute and clean.
# volume: names a volume with no root where there is a volume, else not absolute and clean.
same	C:\repo
same	\\host\share\repo
abs	/a\b
rooted	\repo
absc	C:/repo
volume	C:repo
volume	C:
same	C:/a/../b
same	C:/a/./b
same	C:/a/
same	C:/a//b
abs	/
abs	/repo
same	/a/../b
unc	//host/share
